notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. Compute Engine reference: machine types, instance creation with shielded VM options, startup scripts, instance templates and managed instance groups with autoscaling and rolling updates, Spot VMs, snapshots/images, Terraform, common operations, and troubleshooting.

Following it can make the agent run gcloud commands with the user's authenticated account that enable the Compute API, create/stop/resize instances, create MIGs and start rolling updates, and create snapshot schedules and images. Medium because these change real cloud resources and incur cost; acceptable because they are a standard command reference for the user's own GCP project with no delete-without-confirmation steps and no disabled security controls (the examples enable OS Login and shielded VM features).

The example startup script runs on the new VM, installing nginx and reporting status to the GCE metadata server (SKILL.md:95-104). Instances created with --scopes=cloud-platform (SKILL.md:82) get broad API scope; users should narrow it. Related Skills (SKILL.md:300-303) are named only and do not ship with this skill. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
